highlights: Developed a marksheet extraction pipeline using OpenCV, fine-tuned YOLOv8 for board identification, and Table Transformer for layout detection across different school and college marksheet formats.
Integrated structure-preserving OCR (LLM Whisperer) to extract information from marksheets with varying layouts and tables.
Built a React frontend and asynchronous FastAPI/MySQL backend, enabling automated marksheet processing in approximately 30 seconds per document.
